note: GASActionBuffer::ProcessDeclDict - the constant-pool reader. Retail's this+28 (-1 until the first ActionConstantPool) makes it fill exactly once; this tree rebuilt it on every execution, from whichever movie was running. Ported with the once-only guard, and the pool kept one per GASStringManager

GASActionBuffer::GASActionBuffer(GASStringContext*, GASActionBufferData*) - retail's per-context wrapper around the shared bytecode. This tree has no such split; the per-manager pool is the same contract in one object

GASDoAction::Execute - builds a NEW GASActionBuffer for every execution out of GetMovieRoot()+120 (the movie root's own GASStringContext), queues it with AddActionBuffer and releases it. This is why retail has no shared constant pool
GASDoInitAction::Execute - the same, for a DoInitAction. __Packages.gfx.motion.Tween is one of these, and it is the buffer this package's defect was measured in
GFxSprite::AddActionBuffer - the action queue the per-execution buffer is put on
GASActionBufferData::CreateNew - the refcounted bytecode half, owned by the tag in the shared GFxMovieDataDef
GASActionBufferData::Read(GFxStreamContext*, unsigned) - the bytecode is read once per definition, not per context
GASGlobalContext::GASGlobalContext(GFxMovieRoot*, GASStringManager*) - retail HANDS the context a string manager rather than owning one; the manager lives on GFxMovieRoot::MemoryContextImpl
GFxMovieRoot::GFxMovieRoot(MemoryContextImpl*) - passes a2[4] as that manager. Confirms the manager is above the movie root, not inside it
GASObject::GetMemberRaw - the member lookup whose hash-and-identity compare a foreign interned node misses. This tree's port is faithful; the names reaching it were not
GASObject::SetMemberRaw - the writing half, instrumented by -gfxuitweendiag to name the manager that interned each member name
GASStringManager::CreateStringNode(const char*, unsigned) - interning is per manager, which is what makes a cross-manager GASString compare unequal to its own characters
GASStringNode::ResolveLowercase_Impl - the case-insensitive fallback that would have masked the defect on a movie authored below SWF 7. Every movie in this cook reports version 10, so it never ran
UDisGFxMoviePlayerGlobal::ShowMessageBox - agent EA's port, the route the quit modal and the New Game confirmation both take. Unchanged here; it was already correct and its content was invisible
GFxTextDocView::GetViewRect. GFxTextDocView.h cited 2012 0xa9f2c0, which in retail is inside GFxTextIMEStyle::Unite
GFxEditTextCharacterDef::GFxEditTextCharacterDef. GFxTextField.cpp cited 2012 0xa27200, which is not a function start in retail at all
